verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows the Ghostty app running headlessly or in CI. The runtime probe found only config/+action CLI commands and no remote-control or IPC interface. AppleScript automation (macOS only) still drives a GUI instance. The only headless-capable path is the embeddable `libghostty-vt` library (C/Zig, including WebAssembly), which provides terminal functionality such as parsing without the GUI. That gives glancing, build-it-yourself support. Missing for 10: a documented headless/no-GUI mode for the app, CI usage docs or examples, a remote-control/IPC interface for scripts or agents to send input and read output, and hands-on evidence of CI use.
